commits.message:
fix(docs): a card's failures stand under its code and stay in view while it is (rich-demos-k78j.rzr)

cardCore hands its failures out on their own (failures()), and both card
views place them directly under the editor; the block is sticky to the
window's bottom so a tall editor or output never pushes it out of sight.

Also repairs two example-card e2e assertions that 1cv broke on master: a
crash's failure now folds its stack under the sentence, so they read the
summary.

fix(docs): a live card's crash is said on the card (rich-demos-k78j.1cv) (#373)

* fix(docs): a live card's crash is said on the card, not drawn into its terminal (rich-demos-k78j.1cv)

LiveTerminal ends a crashed program in a 'crashed' state carrying the
report; LiveScreen hands every failure to its card through a required
'failed' prop instead of keeping a second failure surface of its own. The
card's one rich-example-failure says it, located by the same crashSaid the
static runs use, and keeps it through an edit that does not parse.

* fix(docs): live failures keep their stack, unfold the setup, and say a failing exit (rich-demos-k78j.1cv review)

* fix(docs): failure styles outrank .vp-doc p again (rich-demos-k78j.1cv review)
